children.title: DETAILED LETTER OF ACCEPTANCE
DETAILED LETTER OF ACCEPTANCE (a)
children.content:
Ref .:

2\. Your offer submitted for above work tender.

3\. Price negotiation meeting held on 26.08.2022.

Dear Sir,

In continuation to dated 16.09.2022, we are pleased to issue this Detailed Letter of
Acceptance for the subject work on the Terms and Conditions stated in the tender
document and subsequent amendments/corrigendums issued.

You will be entitled to remuneration for the work calculated in accordance with the tender
document and subsequent amendments/corrigendums on the basis of the rates indicated
in the Schedule of Rates Annexed hereto.

1.0 SCOPE OF WORK:

Scope of work under this Contract shall be as detailed in the Tender Document and
subsequent amendments/corrigendums issued.

2.0 CONTRACT VALUE:

The total nominal contract value, excluding CAMC shall be INR xxxx (which is excluding
Goods and Services tax (GST).

Note: Due to system limitation of maximum amount, 2 line items (00010 & 00090) have
been created to accomodate the total amount. These 2 line items are to be read together.

<!-- PageBreak -->

The GST @18% shall be paid as per clause no. 3 & 4 of Special Conditions of Contract Part-
B of tender.

Separate order for Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) covered in
Section B (of SOR) item no. B1.2, B1.3 and B1.4 for an amount of Rs. Xxxxx will be placed
by Panipat Refinery before the expiry of contractual warranty period / defect liability period
as per NIT clause no. 22.0, Appendix-III of NIT and tender terms and conditions.
children.summary: This document is a Detailed Letter of Acceptance for a work tender, issued after a price negotiation meeting on August 26, 2022. It confirms the acceptance of the offer based on the tender's terms and conditions, including any amendments. The contractor will be remunerated according to the rates in the annexed Schedule of Rates. The scope of work is detailed in the tender document. The total nominal contract value, excluding CAMC, is INR xxxx (excluding 18% GST). A separate order for the Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) for Rs. Xxxxx will be placed by Panipat Refinery before the warranty period expires.

children.title: 3.0 PRICE ESCALATION:
children.content:
The quoted prices are firm during the entire period of Contract. Price Variation (Escalation/
De-escalation) in price of MS Plates, structural steel and reinforcement steel shall be as
per Annexure -B-II of Corrigendum1-Commercial dated 11.05.2022 of the tender.
children.summary: This text outlines the pricing terms for a contract. It states that the quoted prices are fixed for the contract's duration. However, there's an exception for MS Plates, structural steel, and reinforcement steel, whose prices are subject to variation (escalation or de-escalation). These specific price adjustments will follow the guidelines detailed in Annexure -B-II of Corrigendum1-Commercial, dated May 11, 2022, which is part of the tender documents.

This document is a Letter of Acceptance for a work tender, issued after price negotiations on August 26, 2022. It confirms the acceptance of the offer based on the tender's terms and conditions, with remuneration according to the annexed Schedule of Rates. The total nominal contract value, excluding the Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC), is INR xxxx (excluding 18% GST). A separate order for the CAMC (Rs. Xxxxx) will be placed by Panipat Refinery before the warranty expires. Contract prices are generally fixed, but prices for MS Plates, structural steel, and reinforcement steel are subject to variation (escalation/de-escalation) as per Annexure -B-II of Corrigendum1-Commercial, dated May 11, 2022.

children.title: 4.0 ADVANCE PAYMENT:
children.content:
Mobilization advance is applicable as per clause no. 6.4.5.0 of General Conditions of
Contract (GCC) and Clause no. 8.2 of Special Conditions of Contract (SCC) Part-B of
tender. The Contractor shall be paid recoverable interest-bearing Mobilization Advance
equivalent up to a maximum of 10% (Ten Percent) of awarded Contract Value (in two
instalments) as per provisions given in clause no. 6.4.5.0 of General Conditions of Contract
and clause no. 8.2 of SCC part-B of tender i.e. up to INR xxxx (Rupees Fifteen Crores Eighty
Lakhs Ninety-Seven Thousand Seven Hundred and Sixty-Seven Only).

5.0 TIME OF COMPLETION:

Time of completion for this work shall be 16 (Sixteen) months from the date of FOA (Fax of
Acceptance) i.e from 16.09.2022.

<!-- PageBreak -->

6.0 SCHEDULE OF RATES:

The Schedule of Rates enclosed with Bidding Document are reproduced and enclosed
hereto in this Detailed Letter of Acceptance (DLOA).

7.0 INITIAL SECURITY DEPOSIT/ SECURITY DEPOSIT:

You are requested to furnish Security Deposit/Initial Security Deposit inline with provision
of clause no 2.1.0.0 of General Conditions of Contract read along with clause no. 46.2 of
Special Conditions of Contract (SCC) Part - A of tender to the Engineer-in-Charge.

8.0 TERMS OF PAYMENT:

Terms of payment for the work shall be as per tender and subsequent
amendments/corrigendums issued.

9.0 CONTRACT AGREEMENT:

You are requested to execute a Contract agreement with us within 30 (Thirty) days from the
date of receipt of this Detailed Letter of Acceptance, on a non-judicial stamp paper of not
less than INR xxxx denomination of Delhi State.

10.0 CONTRACT DOCUMENTS:

The Contract documents shall consist of the following:

i. Contract signed on non-judicial stamp paper

ii. Tender Documents along with subsequent amendments/corrigendums issued.

<!-- PageBreak -->

iii. Letter of Acceptance of Tender (Letter of Acceptance No. dtd. 31.10.2022)

iv. Fax of Acceptance letter no. dated 16.09.2022.

v. Minutes of meeting of price negotiation held on 26.08.2022.

vi. 'Nil' Deviation marked form of Exceptions and Deviations

vii. Letter of waiver

viii. Bidder's Declaration regarding Acceptance of Tender Document

ix. Integrity Pact agreement

11.0 PPLC Declaration details

The PPLC declaration submitted by you along with bid is enclosed herewith for compliance.

12.0 ENGINEER-IN-CHARGE:

Xxxx is EPCM Consultant for the subject project and their Resident Construction Manager
shall be the Engineer-in-Charge for this work. You are requested to contact him
immediately at site for further instructions regarding this work/ contract. Meanwhile you
are requested to prepare and submit a detailed work schedule to him.

You are requested to kindly acknowledge the receipt of this DLOA by returning a copy of the
same after putting your signature and stamp on each page for our record.

Thanking you,
Yours sincerely,

<!-- PageBreak -->
children.summary: This document outlines key contractual terms for a project. It details that a recoverable, interest-bearing mobilization advance, up to 10% of the contract value (INR 15,80,97,767), is available in two installments, as per GCC and SCC. The project's completion time is 16 months from September 16, 2022. It also specifies that the Schedule of Rates is enclosed, and the contractor must furnish a Security Deposit. Payment terms follow the tender and its amendments. A contract agreement must be executed within 30 days on a non-judicial stamp paper. The contract documents include the signed contract, tender documents, letters of acceptance, negotiation minutes, and other declarations. The Engineer-in-Charge is the Resident Construction Manager of the EPCM Consultant, who the contractor should contact for instructions and to submit a work schedule. The contractor is requested to acknowledge receipt of this Detailed Letter of Acceptance.

children.title: CONTRACTOR'S ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
children.content:
We acknowledge the Detailed Letter of Acceptance in totality (signed and sealed by person
holding Power of Attorney).

For and on behalf of

ENCLOSURES TO DLOA

1\. Schedule of Rates

2\. PPLC declaration
children.summary: This text is an acknowledgement of a "Detailed Letter of Acceptance" (DLOA) that has been fully accepted, as indicated by a signature and seal from someone with Power of Attorney. The DLOA includes two enclosures: a "Schedule of Rates" and a "PPLC declaration."

summary: This document is a Letter of Acceptance for a work tender, issued on August 26, 2022, after price negotiations. It confirms acceptance of an offer based on tender terms, with remuneration detailed in an annexed Schedule of Rates. The contract value is INR xxxx (excluding 18% GST), with a separate CAMC order to follow. While prices are generally fixed, those for MS Plates, structural, and reinforcement steel are subject to variation. A 10% mobilization advance (INR 15,80,97,767) is available in two installments.
